ValidationRule.description: Ties the shared GTR customer code to the Greentech family, both ways: an Account whose Name contains Greentech must have Naming_Acronym__c = GTR (blank fails too, or its Opportunities get no project code), and no other Account may use GTR.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Greentech accounts must use the naming acronym GTR, and GTR is reserved for Greentech accounts only.
